sections.body: The primary outcome is 30 minutes; 15/60 minutes and section/16:00 endpoints provide context. Fixed horizons cannot extend past RTH. Excursions exclude the completed signal bar's earlier high/low. Delayed-confirmation outcomes start at the confirmation close. Favorable/adverse threshold touches do not establish executable fill order.
